name: Step 2 — UPRO + TQQQ (6-State)
description: 6-state machine with two independent sleeves: UPRO (3x SPY) and TQQQ (3x QQQ). Defensive states are triggered independently per index, allowing partial defense. Kill switch exits both sleeves to cash. This is the primary production strategy.
data_period: 2019-2026 (live data); Full History toggle available back to 2011

vixThreshold.label: VIX Kill Switch
vixThreshold.tier_note: Ravi's fear-gauge threshold (VIX>30 = get defensive). Locked in the headline optimization pass.

smaKill.label: SMA Period (Kill)
smaKill.tier_note: Ravi's 200-day trend line. Locked in the headline optimization pass. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

cooldown.label: Cooldown Days
cooldown.tier_note: Never actually implemented anywhere (not this engine, not the browser one) until 2026-09-24, despite the slider existing. Blocks re-entry for N trading days after the kill switch fires, even if conditions clear. A genuinely new, unconfirmed rule -- not something Ravi asked for or ever saw in action. Default of 5 days changes Step 2's default trade count/CAGR versus the previously-shown numbers; see OURS_VS_CLIENT_COMPARISON.md.

smaDef.label: SMA Period (Defense)
smaDef.tier_note: Ravi's 50-day trend line. Locked in the headline optimization pass. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

confirmDays.label: Confirm Days
confirmDays.tier_note: Held fixed at 2, never optimized, as of 2026-09-24. When freed, a 200-trial pass pushed this to 14 -- but real SPY/QQQ streaks below/above the 50-day average almost never last that long (empirically: only 17% of real episodes reach 14 days, vs 73% reaching 2 days), so confirmDays=14 doesn't mean 'wait for stronger confirmation' -- it means the defensive-trim rule almost never fires at all (measured: defensive-state days dropped from 7.4% of the test period at the default to 3.6%). It scored well purely because 2011-2021 rewarded staying invested, which is exactly the kind of thing that looks smart in a backtest and hurts badly the one time a real crash isn't in the tested years. 2 is close to the median real episode length (3 days) -- long enough to filter single-day noise, short enough to still catch most genuine weakness.

reentryImmunityDays.label: Fresh Position Grace Period
reentryImmunityDays.tier_note: Ravi's own number, confirmed directly with the client (WhatsApp, 2026-05-24) -- the single most-discussed refinement across the whole engagement, called 'blanketing' or 'defensive confirm days' in the original meetings. After a fresh full re-entry, the fast 50-day trim rule is switched off for this many days, so it can't immediately chop a brand-new position back down before the 50-day average catches up to the 200-day one. Fixes the exact 'buy high, sell low' pattern Ravi called out directly in the trade logs (raised in meetings 3, 4, and 5). Measured effect when this was built: CAGR improved from ~20.3% to 23% (Step 1) and ~20.4% to 22.6% (Step 2) versus no grace period. Applies only to the 50-day defensive trim -- the VIX/200-day kill switch is deliberately never affected by this and always fires immediately (see Section 4/9 of the whipsaw investigation for why that asymmetry itself became a separate finding).

defSell.label: Defensive Sell %
defSell.tier_note: Never specified by Ravi -- an implementation choice. Fair game for optimization. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

rsiPeriod.label: RSI Period
rsiPeriod.tier_note: Ravi named the overbought/rebuy levels (75/60), not the lookback window. Fair game for optimization. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

rsiOB.label: RSI Overbought (Trim)
rsiOB.tier_note: Ravi's overheat/trim level. Locked in the headline optimization pass.

rsiRe.label: RSI Rebuy Level
rsiRe.tier_note: Ravi's rebuy level. Locked in the headline optimization pass.

rsiTrim.label: RSI Trim %
rsiTrim.tier_note: Never specified by Ravi -- an implementation choice. Fair game for optimization. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

uproSplit.label: UPRO Split
uproSplit.tier_note: Never specified by Ravi -- an implementation choice. Fair game for optimization. Range widened 50-90 -> 10-90 on 2026-09-24: the first 200-trial optimization pass hit the old min=50 floor in both the confirmed-locked and free-everything region picks, a sign the true optimum was probably outside the searched range.

capital.label: Initial Capital
capital.tier_note: Account size, not a strategy setting. Never optimized.
